input: Apply to a local community radio station show

gold.taskTitle: Apply to a Local Community Radio Station Show
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to apply to host or participate in a show at a local community radio station.

questions.title: Are you applying to host your own show or join an existing one?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants to pitch and run their own program or become part of an already running show.

questions.title: What topic or format do you have in mind for the show?
questions.description: Understand the subject matter, genre, or style the user wants to present on air.

questions.title: Have you already identified a specific station to apply to?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a target station or still needs to research options in their area.

questions.title: What is your deadline or ideal start date for going on air?
questions.description: Establish the user's timeline so the plan can be appropriately paced.

questions.title: Do you have any prior radio, podcasting, or presenting experience?
questions.description: Assess relevant background that may affect how the application or demo needs to be prepared.

questions.title: Does the station require a demo recording as part of the application?
questions.description: Find out if producing an audio demo is a known or expected requirement for this application.

questions.title: Are you doing this solo or with a co-host or team?
questions.description: Clarify whether other people are involved, which affects coordination and how the application is structured.
